notes.title: Announcement: Release of the Successor, Fairy Card Battlers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169569/ea9bbd9d96fb8f4841f5e55cd2b8d31ae47a947e.png[/img]

The spin-off game Fairy Card Battlers, derived from Fairy Card Rogue, has been released!

In this new game, the adorable fairies from the Touhou Project still use ability cards to do all sorts of things, but unlike Fairy Card Rogue, this title features a new deck-building and head-to-head battle style.

To celebrate the release, it's currently available at 10% off. If you enjoyed Fairy Card Rogue, we hope you'll give this one a try!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2581910/_/

notes.title: Spring Score Attack is Started!
notes.content:
Score attack event #3 has begun as of 4/6.
This event is based around use of the Tengu deck.
The Luna Dial isn't exactly easy to use... Can tengu Lily manage to master it?

In addition to the event, the following changes have also been made.
-In-game notifications will also be available in English from here on out.
-One potion has been added.

notes.title: Fixing a Glitch in the Survey
notes.content:
Due to some problems with the transmission of survey responses, we are releasing an emergency corrected version.
Also, when you update your survey, the information that you submitted the survey will be reset, so you will need to submit the survey again to receive the rewards.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you submitted the survey in 1.15, please submit it again.

notes.title: Version 1.15 is Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43169569/b00120dc596041bee9d3ae809512513353b26775.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Fairy Card Rogue.
In order to better continue updating the game,
I'm launching a survey to use as reference.
For anyone who participates by answering,
you'll receive an in-game bonus item as a gift (card sleeves).

Any participation would be appreciated.


* The survey will be active until 2/28/2023.
*Only the development staff will be able to view the results.
 They won't be used outside of future development.
*You can only respond to the survey once,
 but you can stop, save your answers, and resume later.

* Survey data and gameplay data sent will be used
as a reference to improve future updates.
It may also be made public in the form of statistics,
but no data linking to your identity will be publicized.

Dear Player.
The 2nd Score Attack event is upon us!

====================================

Event #2: Nazrin no Sagashimono? Collab

Run Duration
2022.12.22 ~ 2023.1.23
(Times provided in JST.)

A collaboration event with the in-development
game "Nazrin no Sagashimono?" by LittlePrayer!
Nazrin-related cards will make an appearance.
Collect lots of treasures and make it to the goal!

Participation Requirements:
-Player Level 3

Event-Specific Rules:
-Miko deck, Normal difficulty
-Event-specific starting deck and map layout
-Event cards will drop and appear in shops
-Treasures give 3x score bonus
-Starts on 2F, ends after finishing 3F
Correspondence to the problem of game display corruption in some OS language settings
